summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature. Changes: rich/tree.py adds an iterative Tree.__rich_measure__ (explicit stack, level-based indent of 4 per level) and imports Measurement. rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, constrains Align's rendering to the measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width), and adds a public VerticalCenter class with repr, render (newline-based vertical padding using console.size.height), and measurement. rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options while still passing justify into _collect_renderables. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased with an Added subheading listing the two entries. tests/test_align.py imports VerticalCenter and adds repr, render, measure, and Align-constraint tests. tests/test_tree.py imports Measurement and adds a tree measurement test expecting (11, 19). Caveats: no tests were run, per instructions, so everything is unverified. The Align constraint test expected output was derived by reading the code. Nothing was committed.
